_readme: Azlan's real field work, in his own numbers. Nothing here is guessed: a null number is simply not shown. A photo appears on the About page only when its file exists, it has width and height, and consent is true (the people in it agreed to it being published). Each photo may carry its own "place"; the stamp falls back to the village. Process photos first with: npm run photo:prepare -- <file> Published photos are the whole frame at 1600x1200, uncropped; only the street-address and coordinate lines and the map tile of the camera's stamp are veiled (place, date and time stay).
programme: Community Service Project, G. Pulla Reddy Engineering College, Kurnool
